_comment: The GitHub-hosted CI shape (CI v4, docs/CI.md).
PR runs execute every unit class EXCEPT nightly_only_unit, split into
unit_shards balanced jobs, plus the UI smoke classes from smoke-suite.json.
The nightly workflow runs nightly_only_unit with repeats and the whole UI
suite in nightly_ui_shards jobs. scripts/plan-tests.py hosted validates this
file against the discovered inventory, so a renamed class fails the plan.
nightly_only_unit holds the timing/performance/dormancy families: they
measure scheduling and rendering behaviour, so they run with repeats off
the PR path instead of blocking every merge on a shared runner.
